Cleveland |asst_coach3=[[Scotty Thurman]] |stadium=[[Bud Walton Arena]] |bowl=[[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = First Round }} {{2017–18 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]], who was in his seventh season. The Razorbacks played their home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 23–12, 10–8 in SEC play to finish in a three-way tie for fourth place. As the No. 6 seed in the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]] and [[2017–18 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2017–18 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]]. Senior guard Jaylen Barford was named first-team All-SEC, while senior guard Daryl Macon was a second-team All-SEC selection. Freshman center Daniel Gafford was named to the SEC All-Freshman Team. On March 26, 2018, Gafford announced he would forgo the 2018 NBA draft and would be returning to Arkansas for his sophomore season. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Razorbacks]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 26–10, 12–6 in [[2016–17 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for third. In the [[2017 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball team|Ole Miss]] and [[2016–17 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] before losing to [[2016–17 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the tournament championship. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] for the second time in three years as a #8 seed in the South region. There, they defeated #9 [[2016–17 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] before falling to top seed and eventual national champion [[2016–17 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the round of 32. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
